title: Mi casa y mis habitaciones
who: un nene de 9 (A2), frases cortas, mezcla espanol, con errores

transcripts.text: Hi there! I am Nova, your explorer friend. Today we are going to explore our houses and discover what we do in each room. Tell me, what is your favorite room in your house?
(sin respuesta)
I love my living room because it is very cozy. Do you like your bedroom or the living room more?
(sin respuesta)
Sometimes it is hard to choose! Maybe you like the kitchen because of the snacks? Or do you prefer playing in your bedroom?
(sin respuesta)
I love my bedroom, especially because I have all my toys there! What about you, do you like your bedroom?
Hi there! I am Nova, your adventure partner. Today we are exploring our houses. Look at mine! In my bedroom, I usually read books. What do you usually do in your bedroom?
(sin respuesta)
Sometimes in my room I like to draw. Do you like to play with your toys or sleep in your bedroom?
I play con mis toys y read book, and I sometimes sleep en mi bedroom. 😴🏠
That is awesome! You play with your toys and read books in your bedroom. Excellent! And do you usually play in your bedroom in the morning or in the evening?
I usually play in the morning because I have energía, but sometimes I also play en the evening. 🌞🌙
That is great! You have a lot of energy in the morning. Since you play with your toys, do you also like to build things with them in your bedroom?
